channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: mixed (±0.0).

item.title: [+2] US waives Russia-linked sanctions and tariffs that threatened 100% duties on India over Russian oil
item.description:
The order came two days before the law's measures took effect; it also covers China and three others. The waiver is temporary and existing Russia sanctions stay. Russia supplied about 45% of India's crude in August. Reverses an escalating threat.

Oil, gas & power: tailwind (+2) — Russian crude purchases can continue

Why it matters: Removing the 100% tariff threat protects Indian exports to the US and lets refiners keep buying discounted Russian crude, easing the import bill and trade risk ahead of the US Secretary of State's visit.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Fiscal & trade balance +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Brent jumps 3.7% to $109.86 after touching $110 for the first time since May
item.description:
Hormuz crude shipments are near 70% of pre-war levels, a missile was intercepted near Saudi Arabia's Red Sea bypass port, and Ukraine resumed refinery strikes. US and IEA stock releases did not cap prices. Escalating from $105.92.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Fuel retailers squeezed

Why it matters: Crude near $110 sharply widens India's import bill, lifts fuel and freight costs and wholesale inflation already at 11.39%, and pressures the rupee and reserves.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Forex reserves fall $8.58 billion to $726.03 billion as the RBI defends the rupee
item.description:
In the week to 9 October, foreign currency assets fell $7.14 billion and gold $1.32 billion. Reserves are about $60 billion below the record $785.7 billion in early September. A fifth weekly drop, but smaller than the prior $12.95 billion. Ongoing.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Oil import demand drains reserves

Why it matters: Steady reserve drawdown shows the cost of defending the rupee; with oil near $110 the pace may pick up, limiting the RBI's room.

Market gauges: Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] UAE-owned supertanker and another tanker hit in Hormuz; US signals strike on an Iranian site
item.description:
India's ports ministry reported the strikes; 24 Indian seafarers are safe. A mine sank a cargo ship. The US president signalled a strike on a fortified Iranian site but ruled out nuclear weapons. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Gulf supply risk

Why it matters: Renewed US strike threats after last week's midterm pledge raise the risk of wider war and longer Hormuz disruption, keeping crude, LNG and freight costs high for India.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India expands crude sourcing to 41 countries; government says oil supply holds firm
item.description:
Diversified buying is keeping supply steady despite Hormuz and Red Sea disruptions. New.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Supply security

Why it matters: Wider sourcing reduces the risk of physical shortages for refiners and fuel retailers, though it does not shield India from high prices.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
